newsitem.title: USA: BASEBALL-RED SOX NAME WILLIAMS NEW MANAGER.
newsitem.headline: BASEBALL-RED SOX NAME WILLIAMS NEW MANAGER.

text.p: The Boston Red Sox Tuesday signed Atlanta Braves third base coach Jimy Williams to manage the team, giving him a two-year contract.

The job, vacant after Kevin Kennedy was fired after the season, is the second chance at a mangerial job for the 53-year-old Williams. He managed Boston's American League East rival, the Toronto Blue Jays, from October of 1985 until getting fired in May of 1989.

"This organisation has a chance to win now," said Williams. "It all starts from the top. Certainly I look forward to the chance to manage. I see our biggest challenges as the need to shore up (the pitching). This team had too many walks last year."
